text:
noah: Heads-up: we're running a rapid social push for the 'Benchmark Sprint' webinar next Fri 8:00am PT. Need X + LinkedIn threads, short partner kit, and a 48h engagement playbook. Who can own scheduling, A/B captions, and first-responder routing? cc @ines @bryce

ines: I can do X scheduling + monitor 0-12h. Suggest 4 micro-posts day-of: announce (8:00am), clip+stat (11:00am), partner reshares (2:00pm), reminder (5:30pm). Need hero 1200x675 + square 1:1 clip + 15s vertical.

bryce: I'll take LinkedIn thread + partner outreach. Plan a short threaded post (3 segments) and a long-form variant for partner channels. Also happy to draft partner plain-text caption.

alvy: Creative checklist from me: hero jpg 1200x675, square png 1080, 30s mp4 (stat overlay), 15s vertical, social-safe alt text, three caption variants (X short, X long, LI long), and a partner plain-text file.

social-bot: Registration URL -> https://redwood.ai/events/benchmark-sprint?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_sprint

noah: CTA UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_sprint, utm_medium=social, utm_source=(twitter|linkedin|partner). Track utm_content for CTA variant (register|save_seat).

ines: For X thread copy idea: 1) tease product win, 2) quick stat + clip, 3) CTA + partner tag. Pin a FAQ reply with timezone conversions and agenda bullets to cut down repeats.

bryce: LinkedIn draft (short): "Benchmark Sprint: measurable latency predictability + unit-cost wins. Live benchmark walkthrough + Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/events/benchmark-sprint?utm_campaign=benchmark_sprint&utm_source=linkedin"

noah: Add a key stat? suggestion: "up to 40% token savings on cache-friendly workloads". Legal?

legal-bot: Approved if labeled "internal benchmark" and shown as a range. Backup copy without stat available.

alvy: Will export clip with stat overlay + CTA and a no-stat variant by Wed EOD. Uploading to #marketing-assets and Drive.

ines: Owners for 48h engagement: X 0-12h = ines, X 12-48h = community on-call; LI 0-24h = bryce, LI 24-48h = sales support. Product Qs -> @alvy for technical clarifications, Demo intents -> route to #ae-inbound.

bryce: Playbook for replies: 1) flag top 15 high-engagement replies, 2) route demo mentions to AE, 3) DM top prospects with quick scheduler, 4) collect partner reshares. We'll compile a 48h engagement report (CTR, signups, replies, partner reshares).

noah: A/B CTA test: Variant A = "Register now" (direct), Variant B = "Save your seat" (softer). We'll tag utm_content accordingly and compare signup rate in first 48h.

alvy: Micro-influencer seed: recommend 5 contacts (tech leads + infra folks). Will prep a seed kit (no links) for partners to copy.

ines: Also prepare canned replies for the top 10 FAQs and drop them in the doc so responders can be quick. I'll pin them for X.

noah: timeline: final assets by Thu 18:00 PT; partner kit to partners Thu 20:00 PT; schedule posts Fri 06:30 PT. social-bot please remind owners 24h before.

social-bot: Reminder scheduled: final assets due 2026-04-09T18:00Z; partner kit due 2026-04-09T20:00Z

bryce: I'll post the LI thread draft and partner caption to the doc for signoff.

alvy: Uploaded mockups to Drive -> https://drive.google.com/benchmark_sprint_assets 

noah: Great. Final checklist: assets (hero/clip/vertical), captions (A/B + partner), UTMs, schedule, owners (ines, bryce, alvy), and engagement playbook. Anything missing?

ines: All good from my side.

bryce: Ready to run.

noah: Thanks team 680
